name: English
title: Tuxistant: talk to your computer
description: A voice assistant for your desktop that runs on your own hardware.
tagline: Talk to your computer. It runs on your hardware, not someone else's.
caps: Spoken answers in about a second

linux: How much disk space do I have left?
Checks your disk and tells you out loud.
Give me a quick pancake recipe.
Answers straight away, using a model on your own machine.
Find my 2024 tax return and send it to my phone.
Searches your files, then sends it with GSConnect.
Which folder is eating my disk?
Runs the right commands and reads you the answer.
macos: Find last year's tax return and AirDrop it to my iPhone.
Searches with Spotlight, then opens AirDrop.
Turn on Do Not Disturb until my next meeting.
Reads your calendar and sets a Focus.
Clear anything in Downloads older than a year.
Shows the list, then moves it all to the Bin.
Why is my Mac running hot?
Finds the busiest app and tells you.
windows: Find my tax return and send it to my phone.
Searches your files, then sends it with Phone Link.
Lists your startup apps and how long each takes.
Shows what it found, then frees the space.

linuxNeeds: GNOME 50 and your own LocalAI server
